EMAIL:
Subject: Our office move to Riverside House

Hello everyone,

Our team is moving from Station Road to Riverside House, 14 Canal Street. Our first working day there is Monday 7 December 2026.

Wednesday 2 December is our last day at Station Road. The office closes at 16:00 that day. On Thursday 3 and Friday 4 December, everyone works from home.

Empty crates arrive on Monday 30 November. Each person gets two. Pack them by 16:00 on Wednesday 2 December. Label them with your name and your team's zone. Do not pack monitors, docking stations or keyboards, because IT moves them. Take your laptop and charger home with you.

At Riverside House, you book a shared desk in the DeskBook app. Booking opens on Monday 30 November. Collect your new access badge at reception from 08:00 on 7 December. Please bring photo ID.

If you have questions about the move, email the move team at move-team@example.com.

Thank you,
The move team

FAQ:
Q: When do we move to Riverside House?
A: Your first working day at Riverside House, 14 Canal Street, is Monday 7 December 2026. [O01]
Q: Where do I work on 3 and 4 December?
A: You work from home on Thursday 3 and Friday 4 December while the movers pack and move the furniture. [O03]
Q: How do I pack my things?
A: You get two moving crates. Pack them by 16:00 on Wednesday 2 December. Label them with your name and your team's zone. [O04]
Q: Will I have my own desk?
A: No, the desks are shared. You book a desk in the DeskBook app. Booking opens on Monday 30 November. [O08]
Q: How do I get into the building on my first day?
A: Pick up your new access badge at the Riverside House reception from 08:00 on Monday 7 December. Bring photo ID. [O10]
